Yveltal

Dark Flying

Kalos · Generation 6 · Legendary Pokémon

Yveltal is a Dark/Flying-type Destruction Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 5.8 m tall and weighs 203 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Attack (131), with a base stat total of 680.
